# 3D 翻转卡

悬停时卡片绕 Y 轴 180° 翻转，正面是标题，背面是详情。

来源：https://github.com/xiyu519/MotionVault/blob/0a201da92e4b4fa7436b1c79c7f249bc66329644/src/components/effects/card/FlipCard.tsx

版本：0a201da92e4b4fa7436b1c79c7f249bc66329644

许可：MIT（保留上游 LICENSE）

触发：hover

## 原始实现提示词

Create a React flip card: on hover, rotate the card 180deg around the Y axis
(0.7s ease-in-out) with preserve-3d and backface-visibility hidden. Front:
white face with title; back: dark face (zinc-950, white text) with details.
Fall back to click-to-flip on touch devices. Pure CSS 3D transforms +
Tailwind.
